questions.stem: In Python 3.12, what is the key difference between asyncio.gather and asyncio.wait?

options.text: gather returns results preserving input order, while wait returns done/pending sets
gather runs threads while wait runs processes

questions.explanation: asyncio.gather preserves the sequential ordering of returned values corresponding to input futures.
questions.why_correct: gather guarantees deterministic result index matching input arguments.
questions.why_user_incorrect: asyncio operates on event loops, not OS threads or processes by default.
questions.learning_notes: Use return_exceptions=True in gather to prevent one task from cancelling the aggregate.

questions.stem: Which Python decorator is used in FastAPI to define an asynchronous dependency injection provider?
questions.explanation: FastAPI uses fastapi.Depends to declare sub-dependencies and shared state across path operations.
questions.why_correct: Depends cleanly manages dependency lifetimes and request context.
questions.why_user_incorrect: @inject is used in external libraries like dependency-injector.
questions.learning_notes: Dependencies can yield to support teardown execution.

questions.stem: How does Python's GIL (Global Interpreter Lock) impact CPU-bound multi-threaded programs in CPython 3.12?

options.text: It restricts bytecode execution to one native thread at a time per interpreter
It doubles CPU execution speed by auto-vectorizing threads
It eliminates the need for locks in user code completely
It forces all I/O operations to be synchronous

questions.explanation: CPython's GIL ensures thread safety by permitting only one thread to execute Python bytecode at any moment.
questions.why_correct: CPU-bound tasks require multiprocessing or subinterpreters to achieve parallel scaling in CPython.
questions.why_user_incorrect: GIL only locks bytecode evaluation, not user data structures during race conditions.
questions.learning_notes: PEP 703 introduces experimental free-threaded CPython.

questions.stem: O'zbek tilida nechta unli tovush mavjud?
questions.explanation: O'zbek adabiy tilida 6 ta unli fonema mavjud: a, o, i, u, o', e.
questions.why_correct: O'zbek tili fonetikasiga ko'ra unlilar soni qat'iy 6 tani tashkil etadi.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Boshqa raqamlar rus tili yoki kirill alifbosi harflari bilan adashtirilgan.

questions.stem: Qaratqich kelishigining qo'shimchasi qaysi javobda to'g'ri ko'rsatilgan?
questions.explanation: Qaratqich kelishigi '-ning' qo'shimchasi orqali hosil bo'ladi va 'kimning?', 'nimaning?' so'roqlariga javob beradi.
questions.why_correct: -ning qo'shimchasi predmetning kimga yoki nimaga qarashli ekanligini ifodalaydi.
questions.why_user_incorrect: -ni tushum, -ga jo'nalish, -da esa o'rin-payt kelishigi qo'shimchasidir.
questions.learning_notes: O'zbek tilida 6 ta kelishik bor: Bosh, Qaratqich (-ning), Tushum (-ni), Jo'nalish (-ga), O'rin-payt (-da), Chiqish (-dan).

questions.stem: Qaysi so'z imlo qoidasiga ko'ra xato yozilgan?
questions.explanation: 'Taajjub' so'zi ikkita 'j' harfi bilan yozilishi shart: taajjub.
questions.why_correct: To'g'ri yozilishi 'taajjub' shaklida bo'ladi.
questions.why_user_incorrect: 'Muvofiq', 'muvaffaqiyat' va 'tafakkur' so'zlari to'liq imlo me'yorlariga mos.
questions.learning_notes: Ikkilangan undoshlar (geminata) talaffuz va yozuvda e'tibor talab qiladi.

questions.stem: Alisher Navoiyning 'Xamsa' asariga kirmaydigan doston qaysi?
questions.explanation: 'Lison ut-tayr' Navoiyning falsafiy dostoni bo'lib, 'Xamsa' tarkibiga kirmaydi.
questions.why_correct: Xamsa dostonlari: Hayrat ul-abror, Farhod va Shirin, Layli va Majnun, Sab'ai sayyor, Saddi Iskandariy.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Boshqa barcha variantlar Xamsa tarkibidagi besh doston qatoriga kiradi.
questions.learning_notes: Xamsa 1483-1485 yillarda turkiy tilda yaratilgan.

questions.stem: O'zbek adabiyotidagi ilk realistik roman qaysi asar hisoblanadi?
questions.explanation: Abdulla Qodiriy 1922-yilda yozib tugatgan 'O'tkan kunlar' o'zbek adabiyotidagi birinchi romandir.
questions.why_correct: 'O'tkan kunlar' asari yangi o'zbek romanchiligiga asos solgan shoh asardir.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Cho'lponning 'Kecha va kunduz' romani 1936-yilda nashr etilgan bo'lib, keyingi davrga tegishli.
questions.learning_notes: Qahramonlari: Otabek, Kumushbibi, Zaynab, Homid.

questions.stem: Amir Temur davlatining poytaxti qaysi shahar bo'lgan?
questions.explanation: Amir Temur 1370-yilda hokimiyat tepasiga kelgach, Samarqand shahrini o'z saltanatining poytaxti deb e'lon qilgan.
questions.why_correct: Samarqand Amir Temur davrida dunyoning eng go'zal va qudratli shaharlaridan biriga aylantirilgan.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Hirot Shohrux Mirzo davrida poytaxt bo'lgan, Buxoro esa xonlik davrida poytaxt bo'lgan.
questions.learning_notes: Amir Temur shiori: 'Kuch — adolatdadir'.

questions.stem: Amir Temur qaysi jangda Usmonli turk sultoni Boyazid I Yildirimni mag'lubiyatga uchratgan?
questions.explanation: 1402-yil 20-iyulda Anqara yaqinida bo'lib o'tgan buyuk jangda Amir Temur g'alaba qozongan.
questions.why_correct: Anqara jangi Yevropaning Usmonli imperiyasi tomonidan zabt etilishini 50 yilga kechiktirgan.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Kondurcha va Terek janglari To'xtamishxonga qarshi bo'lgan.
questions.learning_notes: Amir Temur harbiy san'atda yengilmas sarkarda sifatida tarixda qolgan.

questions.stem: O'zbekiston Respublikasining davlat mustaqilligi qachon e'lon qilingan?
questions.explanation: 1991-yil 31-avgustda Oliy Kengashning navbatdan tashqari sessiyasida O'zbekistonning davlat mustaqilligi e'lon qilingan.
questions.why_correct: 1-sentabr esa Mustaqillik bayrami kuni sifatida nishonlanadi.
questions.why_user_incorrect: 1992-yil 8-dekabrda Konstitutsiya qabul qilingan.
questions.learning_notes: O'zbekiston BMTga 1992-yil 2-martda a'zo bo'lgan.

questions.stem: Qadimgi Turon xalqlarining muqaddas diniy va yozma yodgorligi qaysi manba hisoblanadi?
questions.explanation: Zardushtiylik dinining muqaddas kitobi 'Avesto' Turon zaminida yaratilgan eng qadimgi manbadir.
questions.why_correct: Avesto miloddan avvalgi 1-ming yillik boshlarida shakllangan.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Behistun qoyatosh yozuvlari Eron shohi Doro I buyrug'i bilan yozilgan.
questions.learning_notes: Avestoning eng qadimiy qismi 'Gatlar' Zardusht tomonidan aytilgan deb hisoblanadi.

questions.stem: Massagetlar malikasi To'maris Eron shohi Kir II ning bosqinchi qo'shinini qachon tor-mor keltirgan?
questions.explanation: Miloddan avvalgi 530-yilda To'maris jasorati tufayli forslar shohi Kir II ning qo'shini butunlay mag'lub etilgan.
questions.why_correct: Ushbu mashhur jang Gerodotning 'Tarix' asarida batafsil yoritilgan.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Miloddan avvalgi 329-yilda Makedoniyalik Iskandar O'rta Osiyoga bostirib kirgan.
questions.learning_notes: To'maris jasorati vatanparvarlik va ozodlik kurashining buyuk timsoli sanaladi.

questions.stem: Qadimgi Misr podsholari qanday unvon bilan atalgan?
questions.explanation: Qadimgi Misrda oliy hukmdorlar Fir'avn (Pharaoh) deb atalgan.
questions.why_correct: Fir'avn so'zi 'katta uy' ma'nosini berib, shoh hokimiyatini ifodalagan.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Sezar Rimda, Xoqon turkiy davlatlarda qo'llanilgan.
questions.learning_notes: Mashhur fir'avnlar: Ramses II, Tutanxamon, Xufu (Xeops).

questions.stem: Birlashgan Millatlar Tashkiloti (BMT) rasman qaysi yili tashkil topgan?
questions.explanation: Ikkinchi jahon urushidan so'ng, 1945-yil 24-oktabrda San-Fransiskoda BMT ustavi kuchga kirgan.
questions.why_correct: 24-oktabr har yili Xalqaro BMT kuni sifatida nishonlanadi.
questions.why_user_incorrect: 1919-yilda Millatlar Ligasi tuzilgan bo'lib, keyinchalik o'z faoliyatini to'xtatgan.
questions.learning_notes: BMTning bosh qarorgohi AQSHning Nyu-York shahrida joylashgan.

questions.stem: Birinchi jahon urushi qaysi yillarda bo'lib o'tgan?
questions.explanation: Birinchi jahon urushi 1914-yil 28-iyuldan 1918-yil 11-noyabrgacha davom etgan.
questions.why_correct: Urush Kompyen sulhi bilan yakunlangan.
questions.why_user_incorrect: 1939–1945 yillarda esa Ikkinchi jahon urushi bo'lib o'tgan.
questions.learning_notes: Urush Antanta va Uchlar ittifoqi o'rtasida global miqyosda kechgan.

questions.stem: Hisoblang: 48 + 37 nimaga teng?
questions.why_correct: Oddiy arifmetik qo'shish qoidasiga ko'ra yig'indi 85 ga teng.
questions.why_user_incorrect: O'nlikdan o'tishda xatolik qilingan.
questions.learning_notes: Boshlang'ich arifmetik amallar aniqlikni talab qiladi.

questions.stem: Hisoblang: 14 * 6 nimaga teng?
questions.why_correct: Ko'paytirish jadvali qoidasi bo'yicha javob 84.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Boshqa variantlar noto'g'ri ko'paytirish oqibatidir.
questions.learning_notes: Ko'paytirishning taqsimot qonuni: (a + b) * c = a*c + b*c.

questions.stem: 350 sonining 20 foizini (20%) toping.
questions.why_correct: 20% sonning beshdan bir qismiga teng: 350 / 5 = 70.
questions.why_user_incorrect: 35 soni 10% ga teng, 70 esa 20% ga to'g'ri keladi.
questions.learning_notes: Sonning p foizini topish uchun sonni p ga ko'paytirib 100 ga bo'lamiz.

questions.stem: Tenglamani yeching: 5x - 15 = 35. x ning qiymati nechaga teng?
questions.why_user_incorrect: Tenglamaning o'ng tomoniga sonni ishorasini teskari qilib o'tkazish kerak.
questions.learning_notes: Chiziqli tenglamalarda ozod sonlar o'ng tomonga qarama-qarshi ishora bilan o'tadi.

questions.stem: Kvadrat tenglamaning ildizlarini toping: x² - 7x + 12 = 0.
questions.explanation: Viyet teoremasiga ko'ra: x1 + x2 = 7, x1 * x2 = 12. Demak, 3 va 4.
questions.why_user_incorrect: -3 va -4 yig'indisi -7 bo'ladi, bizda esa +7 bo'lishi kerak.
questions.learning_notes: Keltirilgan kvadrat tenglamada Viyet teoremasi: x1 + x2 = -p, x1 * x2 = q.

questions.stem: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning katetlari a = 6 sm va b = 8 sm bo'lsa, uning gipotenuzasi (c) necha sm?
questions.explanation: Pifagor teoremasiga ko'ra: c² = a² + b² = 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100. c = √100 = 10 sm.
questions.why_correct: Misr uchburchagi qoidasi (3:4:5 nisbat): 6, 8, 10.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Katetlar kvadratlari yig'indisidan ildiz chiqarish lozim.
questions.learning_notes: Pifagor teoremasi: to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda gipotenuza kvadrati katetlar kvadratlari yig'indisiga teng.

questions.stem: Hisoblang: log₂ 64 ning qiymati nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: 2 ning nechanchi darajasi 64 ga teng? 2⁶ = 64. Shuning uchun log₂ 64 = 6.
questions.why_correct: Logarifm ta'rifiga ko'ra a^c = b bo'lsa, log_a b = c bo'ladi.
questions.learning_notes: Logarifm — berilgan asosni kerakli songa yetkazish uchun kerak bo'lgan daraja ko'rsatkichidir.

questions.stem: Trigonometrik ifodaning qiymatini toping: sin²(42°) + cos²(42°) + cos(60°).
questions.explanation: Asosiy trigonometrik ayniyat bo'yicha: sin²α + cos²α = 1. cos(60°) = 0.5. Demak, 1 + 0.5 = 1.5.
questions.why_correct: sin²(42°) + cos²(42°) = 1 ayniyati har qanday burchak uchun o'rinli.
questions.why_user_incorrect: cos(60°) = 1/2 qiymatini yodda tutish lozim.
questions.learning_notes: Asosiy ayniyat: sin² x + cos² x = 1.

questions.stem: Hosilani hisoblang: f(x) = 2x³ - 6x² + 5x - 7 funksiyaning x = 1 dagi hosilasi f'(1) nimaga teng?
questions.why_correct: (xⁿ)' = n*xⁿ⁻¹ differensiallash qoidasi to'g'ri tatbiq etilgan.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Doimiy sonning hosilasi 0 ga teng: (-7)' = 0.
questions.learning_notes: Funksiyaning hosilasi o'zgarish tezligini ko'rsatadi.

questions.stem: Aniq integralni hisoblang: ∫₀² (3x²) dx nimaga teng?
questions.explanation: Boshlang'ich funksiya F(x) = x³. Nyuton-Leybnits formulasi: F(2) - F(0) = 2³ - 0³ = 8.
questions.why_correct: ∫ 3x² dx = x³ bo'lib, chegaralari 0 dan 2 gacha olinganda 2³ = 8 chiqadi.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Boshlang'ich funksiyani topishda ko'paytuvchini integrallash qoidasi: ∫ x² dx = x³/3.
questions.learning_notes: Nyuton-Leybnits formulasi: ∫ₐᵇ f(x)dx = F(b) - F(a).

questions.stem: В каком слове пишется буква 'О'?
questions.explanation: В корне слова 'шорох' пишется 'о' (слово-исключение под ударением после шипящих).
questions.why_correct: Слова 'шёпот' (шептать), 'жёлтый' (желтеть) проверяются однокоренными словами с 'е'.
questions.why_user_incorrect: Остальные слова пишутся через 'ё'.
questions.learning_notes: После шипящих под ударением в корне пишется 'ё', если есть чередование с 'е'.
